about_the_game:
The Cosmos Needs Hunters. Are You Up for the Challenge?

An alien scourge ravages the cosmos. You are a HUNTER, the galaxy’s elite defense. Deploy in this top-down roguelite arena shooter and take the fight to the enemy.

Enter small, fast-paced arenas where you must eliminate all enemies. Engage in quick, action-packed missions, experiment with powerful abilities and augments, and unlock unique cosmetics to customize your appearance.

The system’s last hope rests on your trigger finger. Will you rise to the challenge?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains frequent violence against alien and robotic entities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7200U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 930MX / AMD Radeon R5 M430
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9600KF
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

short_description: Fight, die, repeat! VOXEL Hunters is a 1-4 player co-op, top-down roguelite shooter. Team up to blast and defend through a sprawling alien solar system. Upgrade, strategize, and face endless challenges in an epic fight for survival!
